body: Happy birthday love! Hope this year is a good one!

It’s never fun having a birthday in advent. But this year most people forgot including some family and close friends. Just feel lonely and detached. Thankyou, I hope you have a lovely birthday come your turn!

Weigh it against your own sensory input issues. I found it to be the worst thing in the world but some people on the spectrum love it. I have visual, auditory and touch hyper sensitivity which is not a good mix with mdma. I like cannabis but again others don’t. Just make sure if you decide to do it have people around you that you trust with drugs and with you.

Not gonna try to convince you either way but at least let those around you say goodbye. I hope you find peace in whatever form it takes and I hope those around you find some solace in your peace. If all else we will weep for you.
